purpose: Teach: 追い込ま/役に立た/内定/対価/昇格/年数/クオリティ/安値

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究、追い込まれる前に、計画的に進めろ。
lines.en: Ren — work on your research methodically, before you get backed into a corner.
lines.style: Measured, composed. Light emphasis on 'methodically.' The tone of someone who has seen corners before. Steady eye contact, slight lean forward — this matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。役に立たない参考文献、削除します、論文から。
lines.en: Yes. I'll remove the useless references from the paper.
lines.style: Quiet, focused nod in his voice. No flourish. Accepting the direction and already mentally sorting through citations. Slight upward inflection at the end — ready for the next thing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 卒業後の進路、君も、内定、決まったか。
lines.en: And your post-graduation plans — have you settled on something?
lines.style: Conversational shift. Slight warmth underneath the directness. Checking in, not interrogating. Pacing relaxes slightly, like he's genuinely curious now.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究の対価として、奨学金、いただいています。
lines.en: Yes. I've received a scholarship through the research program.
lines.style: Straightforward, respectful without stiffness. Matter-of-fact pride — not showing off, just stating what is. Even pace, clear articulation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: インターンから正社員への昇格、君にも、可能性があるぞ。
lines.en: There's real potential for you to move from internship to full employment here.
lines.style: Deliberate and unhurried. Slight emphasis on 'real.' The delivery of something he means — not a throwaway line. Watching Ren's reaction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究年数、博士課程まで、続けたいです。
lines.en: Yes. I'd like to continue through a doctoral program, keep researching.
lines.style: Quiet conviction underneath. Not defensive, just clear about what he wants. Slight catch of nervousness — sharing ambition is harder than taking direction. Steady though.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 論文クオリティ、海外査読を、目指せ。
lines.en: Aim for international peer review on your papers.
lines.style: Back to directive mode, but warmer now. Slight nod of approval in the tone. Not a command — a trajectory. Short, clean.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。安値で論文を売る学術誌、避けたいです。
lines.en: Yes. I want to avoid journals that prioritize quantity over rigor.
lines.style: Firm but not resentful. He knows what matters. Slight edge of disgust at 'quantity over rigor' — he's thought about this. Finishing strong, owning his standards.
